newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westgold has 14.99 pct of Bolnisi.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westgold has 14.99 pct of Bolnisi.

text.p: Westgold Resources NL said on Monday it has acquired 20.12 million shares in Bolnisi Gold NL, representing 14.99 percent of Bolnisi's capital.

Westgold, which is involved in a merger with Ramsgate Resources NL, said it acquired the shares on the market on Friday at a price of 16 cents each. Bolnisi stock has traded between 16 cents and 5.7 cents this year.
Bolnisi, which is involved in gold mining in the former soviet republic of Georgia, has a market capitalisation of A$21.46 million.
